Other Causes of Zinc Deﬁciency
Under normal physiological conditions, zinc is secreted into the intestine in large quantities together with digestive juices, but is
largely reabsorbed. Diarrhea may not only lead to a reduced absorption of dietary zinc during the episode due to decreased intes-
